name: CMOS two-bit binary CAM row
description: Two writable six-MOS SRAM cells drive four-NMOS mismatch trees on a shared precharged match line. A clock footer, miss inverter and two search-complement inverters bring the total to 28 MOS. A matching stored/search word leaves ml high and miss low; any mismatch discharges ml. All four stored words and all four searches are checked, plus storage bits. This compares a retained word rather than two continuously driven inputs; write bitlines are differential and search runs only after write. Search delay, retention yield, disturb margins and PVT are not qualified.
